description: Implementation of QuicCoalescedPacket class for managing coalesced QUIC packets, including coalescing, clearing, and packet management functions.

classes.name: QuicCoalescedPacket
classes.description: Manages a coalesced QUIC packet, supporting coalescing, clearing, and packet inspection.

methods.name: MaybeCoalescePacket
methods.description: Attempts to coalesce a serialized packet into the current coalesced packet, considering size and address constraints.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the coalesced packet to an empty state.

methods.name: NeuterInitialPacket
methods.description: Removes the initial packet from the coalesced packet, updating length and state.

methods.name: CopyEncryptedBuffers
methods.description: Copies encrypted buffers into a provided buffer, returning success status.

methods.name: ContainsPacketOfEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Checks if the coalesced packet contains a packet of a specific encryption level.

methods.name: TransmissionTypeOfPacket
methods.description: Returns the transmission type of a packet at a given encryption level.

methods.name: NumberOfPackets
methods.description: Returns the total number of packets contained within the coalesced packet.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the coalesced packet, including total length, padding, and encryption levels.

methods.name: packet_lengths
methods.description: Returns a vector of lengths of individual packets within the coalesced packet.
